domain/ui-components: UI widgets, pages, layout, styling, accessibility, design of the app (Svelte renderer)
domain/containers: containers, images, pods, volumes, podman/docker engines and machines, compose
domain/kubernetes: Kubernetes contexts, clusters, deployments, kind/minikube/OpenShift resources
domain/extensibility: extensions: extension API, catalog, install/load/bundle of extensions, webviews
domain/foundations: core app behaviour: startup, quit, updates, main process, OS integration, feedback
domain/technical-debt: refactoring, code cleanup, lint rules, migrations with no user-visible change
domain/qe: quality engineering: e2e tests, test failures, test infrastructure
domain/ci-cd: GitHub Actions workflows, pipelines, release automation
domain/cli-tools: CLI binaries managed by the app (kubectl, kind, compose...) install/update/detect
domain/networking: network, remote connections, ports, DNS, proxy at engine level
domain/settings: Preferences / Settings pages and configuration values
area/statusbar: status bar at the bottom of the window
area/extensions: the extension system itself: catalog, install, update, extension API - not one specific extension
area/extension/podman: only the Podman extension code: creating/starting podman machines, installing/updating podman, WSL/Hyper-V/VM - not container or image features
area/extensions/compose: the Compose extension: installing compose, docker-compose / podman compose
area/docker-compatibility: Docker API compatibility, docker CLI working with podman
area/podman-upstream: bugs or updates in podman itself
area/release: release of a new version, release notes
area/tooling: developer tooling, build scripts, agent skills
area/development-mode: running the app in dev mode (pnpm watch)
